verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail offers the mailbox address alongside its own lease-grade TruLease product (lease agreement, physical address, optional utility bill) and its residency-grade TruResidence product, plus a registered agent service included free with mailbox plans, all from one provider. LLC formation is weaker: TruStart provides only self-paced videos and registered-agent templates, not a done-for-you filing. Missing for 10: done-for-you LLC formation filing, explicit foreign-qualification support for TruLease, independent or hands-on corroboration.
